framing.lineOfInquiry: Ajay Bhatia (P00429) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE018
framing.alternate: Ajay Bhatia (P00429) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.statement: Ajay Bhatia was somewhere else when the incident happened.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

evidence.text: Recorded at Dwarka Sector 10 Residential, Delhi, 16.6 km from the scene, 130 min before the incident — the scene was reachable by road in that time, so this is only a partial alibi
Recorded at Dwarka Sector 10 Residential, Delhi, 16.5 km from the scene, 36 min before the incident — the scene was reachable by road in that time, so this is only a partial alibi

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
